errors: First draft (For Other Minds 'Ruled Off', the 2026-11-15 break-in-series proposal) collided with PR #16463 'The Break in the Line', merged by a parallel session while this one was drafting; found only at merge time as a conflict. Dropped it and wrote a different story.

doc_friction.issue: The duplicate-work search (open PRs) can't see a parallel session that hasn't pushed yet. Two sessions took the same single For Other Minds proposal within an hour. Claiming a proposal in BIBLE.md with an early draft PR, or having creative_due.py draw a proposal as well as a shelf, would prevent that.
'git log --oneline -15 -- <shelves>' shows only 3 commits on a shallow clone; README's platform/ci/creative_due.py is the tool that works, and the prompt doesn't name it.
No way to run a subset of --for-changes workflows (no --only), so I ran each one by name; doc-refs-ci needs --force.

deviations.why: Pick from the bible's Next up list: both the open proposals I could take had been taken by parallel sessions (one already merged).
deviations.did: Wrote a proposal of my own (comparing months when Easter moves) and then the story from it in the same run, after checking overlap.mjs.
deviations.result: Story landed; no collision because the proposal existed only on this branch.

notes: Project: Hearth & Horizon, For Other Minds shelf; piece: laetare-with-laetare (moving Easter, same-month comparison, Sunday-aligned comparison). Text only because audio was 577 MB, over the 400 MB cap. Easter dates from the Gregorian computus; weekdays checked in code. Verified: node --test 17/17 in ventures/hearth-and-horizon; post front matter, links and similarity clean; conflict-markers, page-integrity, prompts, sibling-links and link-contrast workflows passed locally (run_workflow_locally). CI had started no check runs when merged. No docs/reports doc, because DONE.md holds the numbers.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: two 3,000-3,500 word number-checked short stories drafted, one discarded

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
